name: plum
description: Plum: an open-source Leptos-to-TypeScript adapter. Leptos owns the state/logic (Rust, view-agnostic); a thin wasm-bindgen bridge pushes values to JS; Nanostores is the public reactive type.

scripts.dev: node scripts/ensure-wasm.mjs && npm run dev -w todomvc-app
scripts.dev:rust: watchexec -w examples/todomvc/model -w rust -e rs -e toml -- npm run build:wasm
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:web
scripts.build:wasm: cargo test -p todomvc-model __plum_export && wasm-pack build examples/todomvc/model --target web --features plum
scripts.lint:rust: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -D warnings
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build && npm run lint && npm run lint:rust
